_about: Hvilken slags? (Tankegang): short, hand-written sentences. Only one kind of logic fits each gap. w = the answer as it stands in s (its first occurrence), card = its logic card, alt = the one other word of the same kind that is shown with it; alt never fits (wrong word order or a clearly different meaning).
